title: 3D File Import & Export Presets
description:
The new update to our hardware in CLO 2025.1 allows you to save import and export settings as presets for 3D files to streamline your workflow.

Check out other new features here:https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio
